list.text: \rOh! You picked up! I was getting worried…\nAre you okay? What happened in there?
\rRed… was hypnotized?!\nThat’s awful… But you were able to snap him out of it?\nThank goodness! I knew if anyone could reach him, it’d be Pika.
\rI ran into some of the grunts who were leaving. They were talking about their next move…\nSomething about their search for Mew.
\rI couldn't hear all the details, but I did hear something weird -- one of them mentioned the Pokémon Association.
\rIt seems their leader will be a candidate in the Pokémon Association elections!\nIf they’re involved with the League somehow...\nThis might be bigger than we thought.
\rI’ll keep digging. Maybe I can figure out what their next move is.\nIn the meantime, stay on guard, okay? If they have connections that high up, you’ll need to be careful.
\rAnd, um… thanks for helping Red. It means a lot.
Oh my!\nI remember there was nothing built here when I climbed the mountain.
Things change, and it's getting more and more convenient.
Hey there, trainer! You’ve got the look of someone who knows how to throw a kick -- at least when it comes to Pokemon battles!
Tell you what, let’s see how dedicated you are. Have you caught at least 50 Pokemon native to Kanto?

then.text: Whoa! That’s some dedication! You’ve earned the right to train with one of our best Fighting-type partners!
I raise Hitmonlee, the master of kicks! If you want speed and devastating strikes, he’s the one for you!
Would you like to take Hitmonlee with you?

branches.text: Excellent! Hitmonlee’s kicks are lightning-fast -- he won’t let you down!
Train him well! A true Fighting-type master always respects their partner!
You can only take one. Choose wisely!

else.text: Hmm… You’ve still got some training to do. Catch more Pokemon and come back when you’re ready!
